A hands-on guide to the **[RatInABox](https://github.com/RatInABox-Lab/RatInABox)**
library, built around one concrete goal: generating **synthetic training data** for computational cognitive 
neuroscience projects. The modules in this site contain a written walk through and code starter notebook. 
Answers are provided for each problem. 

## Pick a Setup Path

There are two ways to run through these modules, via google collab, or your own local env. 
Instructions for both are below.

::: {.grid}

::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-6}
### Virtual env and zero maintenance 
Open any notebook in **Google Colab** and run `pip install ratinabox`. No local
setup required, but your compute and server time is constrained by Google. 
This is the fastest way to work with the modules.

*(Colab launch buttons are coming to each notebook page — for now, download the `.ipynb`
and upload it to [colab.research.google.com](https://colab.research.google.com).)*
:::

::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-6}
### Local env through Pixi
For reproducible synthetic-data generation, use the pinned environment below. 

::: {.callout-tip appearance="simple"}
## Local env prerequisite
Before running these commands you must have [pixi](https://pixi.prefix.dev/latest/#installation) installed on your computer. 
:::

```bash
pixi install       # Scientific libraries
pixi run verify    # sanity-check the install
pixi run lab       # open local JupyterLab
```

```bash
# For notebooks that require pytorch
pixi install -e dl && pixi run -e dl lab
```
:::

:::

## Learning Modules

Work each module's write-up alongside its starter notebook, answers are hidden and can be
revealed at any time. Modules build on each other and it is recommended to work on them in order. 

| # | Module | What you get out of it |
|---|--------|------------------------|
| 1 | [Environments & Agents](modules/module_1_environments_and_agents.md) | Build worlds and drive a realistic simulated animal |
| 2 | [Place cells (CA1 input)](modules/module_2_place_cells.md) | Single-location place codes and rate maps |
| 3 | [Head direction & the cell zoo](modules/module_3_head_direction_velocity_and_the_cell_zoo.md) | HD + angular-velocity inputs |
| 4 | [Mazes, spikes & extraction](modules/module_4_structured_mazes_and_spikes.md) | Structured geometry, Poisson spikes, dataset assembly |
| 5 | [Synthetic-data pipeline](modules/module_5_capstone_synthetic_data_pipeline.md) | Towards a realistic generator for an RNN |

::: {.callout-tip appearance="simple"}
